reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides six coding-oriented skills for minimal implementation guidance, over-engineering review and audits, technical-debt tracking, benefit reporting, and usage help.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一组用于精简编码、过度工程审查、仓库审计和技术债务记录的代理技能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agent skills for minimal coding guidance, over-engineering reviews, repository audits, and technical-debt tracking.

capabilities: Registers six agent skills with the host skills registry
Influences agent code-generation style and implementation choices
Reviews and audits repositories for over-engineering
Collects ponytail comments into a technical-debt ledger
